title: Kaalidas
desc: Honest policeman Kaalidas is tasked with investigating a series of apparent suicides, but it puts a strain on his marriage with Vidyaa, who soon seeks solace in their new tenant.

title: Kedi
desc: Raghu, a happy-go-lucky college student, faces challenges when two girls from different backgrounds fall in love with him.

title: Vrithra
desc: Cop Indra Rao is overwhelmed by a series of disturbing evidence regarding a seemingly open-and-shut case. Following the clues, she must choose one, the truth or her career.

title: Oppam
desc: Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.

title: Devil: The British Secret Agent
desc: Set in pre-independence India, a covert intelligence operative gets tangled in love, deception and betrayal, while investigating the mysterious murder of a zamindar's daughter.
